visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with shoulder-length brown hair wearing a white sleeveless dress and carrying a small tote bag walks through a luxury retail environment. She enters an area marked by OYA/COVA branding. (2) The scene shifts to a formal event with a large multi-tiered white cake decorated with yellow frosting roses. A man in a suit stands next to it while a woman in a white dress plays the cello in the background. (3) Close-up shots of various desserts on white plates appear, including a slice of dark chocolate cake (COVA Sacher) and a yellow sponge cake (Mango Mimosa). (4) Macro visuals show liquid chocolate swirling and apricot jam dripping, transitioning back to the host eating the chocolate cake with a silver fork. (5) The host holds a small gold-wrapped praline up to the camera and takes a bite. She is seated on a light-colored sofa in a bright, upscale indoor space with glass display cases behind her. (6) A montage shows her drinking espresso from a small cup and then white wine/champagne from a flute. (7) Finally, she stands next to a tall, tiered cake with a male chef in a white uniform, both smiling at the camera in a grand, brightly lit mall interior.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main female host, 1 male chef, 2 female musicians, several event guests in the background.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with short brown hair, wearing a white sleeveless shift dress with a scalloped hem and carrying a black and white tote.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The interior of a high-end shopping mall (Taipei 101) with marble floors, luxury brand displays, a grand atrium, and a temporary event space featuring COVA dessert branding and glass pastry cases.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a cheerful, high-pitched female narrator speaking enthusiastically over a mid-tempo, upbeat acoustic jazz track featuring acoustic guitar and piano. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies the transition to the event title card. (3) As the narrator describes the chocolate cake, a shimmering 'sparkle' SFX is heard. (4) A low, liquid 'swish' or splash sound occurs as the visual shows chocolate sauce being stirred. (5) In the middle section, the acoustic BGM continues steadily, but a soft, legato violin melody becomes slightly more prominent in the mix as the host mentions the comfortable atmosphere. (6) Subtle clinking of ceramic coffee cups and liquid pouring sounds are audible as she tastes the espresso. (7) The final segment features a celebratory 'ding' or bell chime as the host poses with the chef, with the upbeat jazz track reaching a final cadence before fading out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Intro -> Product 1 -> Product 2 -> Product 3 -> Atmosphere -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the COVA 10th anniversary press event and introduce its signature and summer-limited desserts (Sacher, Mango Mimosa, Pralines) to the Taiwanese market.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Host explicitly visits the COVA event, describes specific products by brand name, and includes detailed promotional text overlays for each item.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-quality lifestyle production utilizing rapid editing and variety-show style text to keep the viewer engaged with a luxury brand's food products.
